title: Electric Field Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the electric field expression as a function of radial position.

title: Capacitance Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately calculate the capacitance of the cylindrical capacitor.

title: Force Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the expression for the force required to hold the dielectric in position.

title: Direction of Force
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify the direction in which the force must be applied.

title: Use of Gauss' Law
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate the application of Gauss' law in deriving the electric field.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the electric field and force calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
